from pathlib import Path
workspace=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/held-out-2/play/users/u054/system/state/workspace')
programs=workspace/'programs'; programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    p = (y+dy, x+dx)
                    if 0 <= p[0] < h and 0 <= p[1] < w and p not in seen and grid[p[0]][p[1]] == color:
                        seen.add(p)
                        stack.append(p)
            minr = min(y for y, x in cells)
            maxr = max(y for y, x in cells)
            minc = min(x for y, x in cells)
            maxc = max(x for y, x in cells)
            shape = [(y-minr, x-minc, color) for y, x in cells]
            objects.append((minc, minr, maxr-minr+1, maxc-minc+1, shape))
    objects.sort(key=lambda obj: (obj[0], obj[1]))
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    starts = []
    for i, obj in enumerate(objects):
        _, _, oh, ow, shape = obj
        if i == 0:
            sr = sc = 0
        else:
            ph, pw = objects[i-1][2], objects[i-1][3]
            dr, dc = ph-1, pw-1
            # A pair of initial 2x2 blocks is separated by one extra row in the examples.
            if i == 1 and (ph, pw, oh, ow) == (2, 2, 2, 2):
                dr = ph
            sr, sc = starts[-1][0] + dr, starts[-1][1] + dc
        starts.append((sr, sc))
        for y, x, color in shape:
            if 0 <= sr+y < h and 0 <= sc+x < w:
                out[sr+y][sc+x] = color
    return out
'''
path=programs/'task-b3dc8b3b.py'; path.write_text(code)
